title: No-Show Fees on an Appointment Series
content:
**Desk guidance — Patient Services Center.**

**Scope.** A no-show fee on an Appointment Series is charged for a booked appointment, other than the first appointment of the series, that the patient neither attended nor cancelled, and it is worked out on the most recent no-show recorded on the series, the one with the latest appointment date. The fee is booked as one no-show fee entry on the series, tied to the recorded no-show it is for, in US dollars to the cent.

**When the amount is settled.** The no-show fee is fixed only after every late cancellation received before its appointment day and recorded on the series within its fee assessment period carries its late-cancellation fee entry.

**Booking the fee — `assess_no_show_fee_93f38688`.** The tool charges the no-show fee for one booked appointment, other than the opening appointment of the series, that the patient neither attended nor cancelled. One call books one no-show fee against the patient's appointment series, tied to the recorded no-show it is for, and raises the missed-visit fees owed on that series by the amount charged; the patient sees the fee on the series' missed-visit balance and on the next statement. The tool records what it is given and makes no judgement of its own on whether or how much a fee is owed.

It is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `assess_no_show_fee_93f38688` and then calls it, with these parameters:

- `series_id` — the reference number of the patient's appointment series that carries the missed appointment, as returned by the appointment series lookup (text identifier);
- `source_event_id` — the reference number of the recorded no-show entry the fee is for, as returned by the appointment history lookup for that series (text identifier);
- `amount` — the no-show fee to charge, in USD, a positive number given to 2 decimal places (cents); the value is stored exactly as passed after rounding to 2 decimal places.

**What comes back.** A successful call returns `fee_reference` (the reference number of the new fee entry; its presence means the fee was booked), `series_id` (the series charged), `fee_kind` (always `no_show`), `amount` (USD to 2 decimal places, the fee booked), `appointment_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date of the missed appointment), `assessed_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, the date the fee was charged) and `missed_fee_balance` (USD to 2 decimal places, the missed-visit fees owed on the series once this fee is included). No error return is defined.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A call with an `amount` of 62.50 on a series whose missed-visit fees owed stood at USD 35.00 returns `fee_kind` `no_show`, `amount` 62.50 and a `missed_fee_balance` of 97.50.
